init.title: Camera Motion Detection Options
init.description: Configure cloud-based motion detection for your Wyze cameras

data_description.enable_camera_motion: Enable cloud-based motion detection polling for cameras. Turn on individual cameras using the Motion Tracking (Cloud) switches.
data_description.motion_poll_interval: How often to check Wyze cloud for motion events. Lower values = faster detection but more API usage. Minimum: 2 seconds, Recommended: 30 seconds.
data_description.motion_hold_seconds: How long the motion sensor stays 'on' after detecting motion. Prevents rapid on/off flickering. Recommended: 15 seconds.
